title.narrative: The level of communal tensions and violence has diminished and there is increased peaceful interaction between different ethnic and faith communities. The acceptance of value of diversity and the importance of social harmony among all communities residing in Rakhine State in enhanced.
Percentage of the participants who have come to value social harmony and diversity.
Stronger capacity to respond to violence and avoid exacerbating tensions through more conflict sensitive behaviour.
CSOs community leaders have stronger ability to monitor and respond to violence through improved early warning and early response capacity.

target.value: CSOs community leaders have stronger ability to monitor and respond to violence through improved early warning and early response capacity.

actual.value: Although more than 30,000 people have learned about the importance of social harmony and the acceptance of diversity at the trainings and other activities CDNH has organized, very few community members have understand EWER mechanism and conflict sensitivity approaches. CDNH has offered only 10 trainings on conflict sensitivity to community members across Rakhine state. No training on intercultural competence has been organized for any communities in Rakhine State.

target.value: CSOs community leaders have stronger ability to monitor and respond to violence through improved early warning and early response capacity.

actual.value: CDNH organized trainings on rumour management, conflict transformation, social cohesion, and community based early warning and early response. CDNH also organized community dialogues that focused on rumour management and information shearing. Senior government officials and community leaders CDNH had interviewed said that CDNH’s capacity building trainings have prepared them to deal with rumours, especially analysing the information circulating around in their areas.

title.narrative: Reduced segregation between Muslim and Rakhine communities.
Creating more opportunities for both communities to interact with each other.

target.value: Creating more opportunities for both communities to interact with each other.

actual.value: A school was built for joint community dialogues, stakeholder meetings and the women forum. The school building was constructed at the only school in Rakhine State where Muslim and non-Muslim students study in the same classroom.

target.value: Creating more opportunities for both communities to interact with each other.

actual.value: Limited interactions between the two communities.

title.narrative: Contribute to prevention of conflicts, the maintaining of peace and promoting social harmony in Rakhine State.
Increased awareness and understanding of peacebuilding, conflict prevention strategies and human rights among all actors, especially community leaders.

target.value: Increased awareness and understanding of peacebuilding, conflict prevention strategies and human rights among all actors, especially community leaders.

actual.value: 7164 community members attained trainings on peace education and conflict prevention. CDNH also produced 11 major reports and 58 memos/policy briefs on peace building and conflict prevention that were heavily used by various stakeholders including the government in making their policies. Thanks to some of the memos, the government has agreed to allow women groups to undertake the activities that are designed to prevent gender-based violence. Thanks to the peace building trainings provided to women, the women groups from various communities in Rakhine State are now eager to do more to prevent gender-based violence and to provide more protection to children and women in time of communal violence.

target.value: Increased awareness and understanding of peacebuilding, conflict prevention strategies and human rights among all actors, especially community leaders.

actual.value: Only limited number of government officials and community leaders have a good knowledge of peacebuilding and conflict prevention strategy and 17 fewer people are willing to use their knowledge of peacebuilding in promoting social harmony and acceptance of diversity. CDNH has published two Rakhine State Needs Assessments, 3 reports on peacebuilding, 120 memos and 60 situation updates and for all stakeholders to use as sources of baseline data and credible analyses when they undertake activities aiming at conflict prevention. More than 50 CSOs based their decisions on the reports, analyses and news updates provided by CDNH and the knowledge they attained from the trainings run by CDNH.

title.narrative: Contribute to prevention of conflicts, the maintaining of peace and promoting social harmony in Rakhine State.
Increase in culturally and conflict sensitive reactions and activities.

target.value: Increase in culturally and conflict sensitive reactions and activities.

actual.value: Of the 4200 survey participants conducted in November and December 2018, more than 35 percent said they were culturally, conflict and gender sensitive.

target.value: Increase in culturally and conflict sensitive reactions and activities.

actual.value: Survey with about 2,000 community members indicated that only about 20 percent of members of all community residing in Rakhine State were culturally, conflict and gender sensitive.
